Baby Moon Hub Caps for O/E Style Wheels, 10-1/8 Inch Diameter
products.description: This is Garage Sale priced because one hub cap was dented in shipping. These chrome 10-1/8" Diameter Baby Moons are old school cool. They perfectly compliment the Speedway Motors O/E Style Hot Rod steel wheels. Made for 10-1/8" "outside nub" wheels. Chrome plated steel. Set of 4. Will not fit "Smoothie" or "Rally" type wheels. Specifically designed to fit and only work directly with the Speedway Motors O/E Style Hot Rod Style Wheels. Installation Note: The fitment of this cap at the 3 retention points is very tight
